name: Touchdown & Traverse
question: Where on Earth do slope/roughness distributions match the Artemis south-pole landing zones and LTV corridors?

slope_roughness.rule: cell TRANSFERS when in the A12 robust set (native rank >= n_native/2 under configs i, ii, iii)

unobserved_variables: Metre-scale boulders and craters < 60 m: below the 30 m DEM baseline on both sides (LOLA 5 m maps cannot resolve 1-2 m boulders either)

name: Low-Sun Navigation
question: Where does the Sun skim the horizon over bare ground, casting long shadows like at the lunar south pole?
expectation_note: Astro part very likely no-analog on Earth (needs lat >= ~83-86 deg). Valid result, reported as a number.

sun_geometry.rule: lens-level: NO-ANALOG when fidelity no_analog (best sigma > 2), value = best sigma

shadow_casting.rule: cell TRANSFERS when native_rank(d_shadow) >= n_native/2 (rank/seed cells only)

unobserved_variables: Horizon occlusion beyond 10 km: shadows are computed inside the 10 km chip only, on both sides

name: Aqueous Minerals & Biosignature
question: Where on Earth is the same water-altered mineral assemblage exposed today (carbonate, Fe/Mg-smectite, olivine, jarosite)?

excluded_descriptors.BD1750: 14/11 B3: EMIT -0.01 fill starts ~1765 nm in recent scenes -> no right shoulder
excluded_descriptors.HCPINDEX: B14a: continuum-sensitive (CRISM I/F vs EMIT reflectance), bridge-bias table only

pixel_match.source: Viviano-Beck et al. 2014, JGR Planets 119:1403, doi:10.1002/2014JE004627, Table 3 (browse products)

jezero_margin.browse: CR2 (MIN2295_2480; MIN2345_2537 and CINDEX2 not usable: target 0.011 at noise floor / beyond EMIT) + CAR (D2300; BD2500_2, BD1900_2 beyond EMIT or masked)
jezero_margin.label: Mg-carbonate / serpentine family (2.3 um only: the 2.5 um anchor sits at the EMIT edge, so serpentine and Mg-carbonate are not separable)

nili_fossae_olivine.browse: MAF (OLINDEX3; LCPINDEX2, HCPINDEX2 are pyroxene, not olivine diagnostics)
nili_fossae_olivine.label: olivine (broad 1 um band)
nili_fossae_olivine.flag: continuum-sensitive: OLINDEX responds to red slopes / Fe-oxide coatings; low confidence

mg_carbonate_serpentine_2p3um.test: Rover VSWIR mineral mapping and sampling of Mg-carbonate / serpentine (Jezero margin)
mg_carbonate_serpentine_2p3um.rule: TRANSFERS per cell when largest_patch_km2 >= 0.1 AND m1_controls_pass; NO-ANALOG when < 0.1

olivine_1um.test: Rover VSWIR detection of olivine (Nili Fossae / Jezero watershed)

unobserved.reason: Hydration bands at 1.4 and 1.9 um are hidden by Earth's atmosphere in EMIT (CRISM's most sensitive water indicators)
unobserved.facility: In situ VSWIR spectrometer or laboratory spectroscopy of field samples

unobserved.reason: Not separable with 2.3 um alone: the 2.5 um anchor sits at the EMIT edge
unobserved.facility: In situ XRD / Raman or laboratory mineralogy

unobserved_variables: Hydration bands at 1.4 and 1.9 um: hidden by Earth's atmosphere in EMIT (CRISM's most sensitive water indicators)
Serpentine vs Mg-carbonate: not separable with 2.3 um alone (2.5 um anchor at the EMIT edge)

unobserved_targets.oxia_planum: FE_SMECTITE diagnostic depths (D2300 0.030, BD2290 0.015) are at the 0.01 tolerance floor: featureless basalt matches it (empty match). Verdict UNOBSERVED.
unobserved_targets.meridiani: JAROSITE diagnostic depths (BD2265 0.023, BD2210 0.011) are near the tolerance floor in EMIT-usable parameters. Verdict UNOBSERVED.

population_note: Sigma population = all usable MICA type spectra: variation BETWEEN mineral classes on Mars.

name: Ice under Dry Overburden
question: Where is shallow ground ice preserved under a dry, cold overburden, for 1 m drill / GPR / neutron tests?

permafrost.basis: permafrost_flag midpoint; Beacon Valley MAAT -40 C, Mars mid-latitude ~ -60 C

no_thaw_to_ice.basis: Mars: no liquid-water freeze-thaw at the surface (0). Beacon Valley 0; polar deserts 8-13 d/yr; registered wet-permafrost decoys 33-37; Tibet/Pamir 160-230. 20 d/yr chosen after seeing these values.

dry_overburden.basis: UNEP aridity-index upper bound of the semi-arid class (0.5), applied to P / max(PET, 500 mm) (PET floor, see descriptors/ice.py). Beacon Valley 0.21; Mars 0.

data_notes: MAAT: ERA5-Land soil temperature 28-100 cm = reanalysis model output on a ~9 km grid, not an observation
Freeze-thaw days: MODIS clear-sky land-surface temperature (day > 0 C and night < 0 C)

ice_under_dry_overburden.test: 1 m ice drill, ground-penetrating radar and neutron spectrometer on shallow ground ice under a dry overburden
ice_under_dry_overburden.source: data/derived/x1_checklist.parquet (B15: cond_permafrost, cond_no_thaw_to_ice, cond_dry_overburden, ice_check, candidate)
ice_under_dry_overburden.rule: TRANSFERS when candidate (all 3 conditions, not glacier ice); NO-ANALOG listing the failed conditions; evidence max engine-semiquant

unobserved.reason: Overburden dielectric properties (radar / GPR response): no global Earth dataset matched to SWIM radar observables
unobserved.facility: In situ GPR survey on the candidate site

unobserved_variables: Overburden dielectric properties (radar / GPR response): no global Earth dataset matched to SWIM radar observables
